variants.title: Limiting friction: metal faces with a film of oil
variants.sample: Block faced with metal on a metal-faced plank, lubricated
variants.method: Pan and pulley, weights added to the block
variants.unknown: the coefficient of limiting friction between the two faces
variants.note: Metal on metal, lubricated: the handbook value of the static coefficient is 0.15. A thin film of oil keeps the two surfaces apart and cuts friction several times over.

source.title: Serway & Jewett, Physics for Scientists and Engineers, Table 5.1: approximate coefficients of friction (static), metal on metal (lubricated)

variants.title: Limiting friction: waxed wood on wet snow
variants.sample: Waxed wooden block on a tray of wet snow
variants.method: Pan and pulley, weights added to the block
variants.unknown: the coefficient of limiting friction between wax and wet snow
variants.note: Waxed wood on wet snow: static coefficient 0.14. This is why skis are waxed.

source.title: Serway & Jewett, Physics for Scientists and Engineers, Table 5.1: approximate coefficients of friction (static), waxed wood on wet snow

variants.title: Limiting friction: ice on ice
variants.sample: Block of ice on a sheet of ice
variants.method: Pan and pulley, weights added to the block
variants.unknown: the coefficient of limiting friction between ice and ice
variants.note: Ice on ice: static coefficient 0.1, one of the smallest for ordinary solids.

source.title: Serway & Jewett, Physics for Scientists and Engineers, Table 5.1: approximate coefficients of friction (static), ice on ice

variants.title: Limiting friction: Teflon on Teflon
variants.sample: Block faced with Teflon on a Teflon-faced plank
variants.method: Pan and pulley, weights added to the block
variants.unknown: the coefficient of limiting friction between two Teflon faces
variants.note: Teflon on Teflon: static coefficient 0.04, about as small as any pair of dry solids.

source.title: Serway & Jewett, Physics for Scientists and Engineers, Table 5.1: approximate coefficients of friction (static), Teflon on Teflon
